connection.note: client and server on the same machine; MariaDB in Docker Desktop (Linux VM)

environment.cache: warm: every workload runs one un-timed warm-up pass first; the whole dataset fits in the InnoDB buffer pool. Cold-cache behaviour is NOT measured.

results.label: Application time, interval predicate + ORDER BY valid_from DESC LIMIT 1 (production query)
results.sql: SELECT h.rev_id FROM article_history h WHERE h.article_id = ? AND h.valid_from <= ? AND h.valid_to > ? ORDER BY h.valid_from DESC LIMIT 1

results.label: Application time, interval predicate only (optimizer free to choose)
results.sql: SELECT h.rev_id FROM article_history h WHERE h.article_id = ? AND h.valid_from <= ? AND h.valid_to > ?

results.label: Application time, forced through the WITHOUT OVERLAPS index (article_id, row_end, valid_to, valid_from)
results.sql: SELECT h.rev_id FROM article_history h FORCE INDEX (uq_article_history_no_overlap) WHERE h.article_id = ? AND h.valid_from <= ? AND h.valid_to > ?

results.label: No intervals: latest revision event with timestamp <= T (MediaWiki-style)
results.sql: SELECT r.rev_id FROM revisions r WHERE r.article_id = ? AND r.rev_timestamp <= ? ORDER BY r.rev_timestamp DESC, r.rev_id DESC LIMIT 1

results.label: System time: page_mirror FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF T (partitioned by SYSTEM_TIME, 1 year)
results.sql: SELECT m.rev_id FROM page_mirror FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP ? AS m WHERE m.article_id = ?

results.label: System time: identical history in an unpartitioned table (bench_mirror_flat)
results.sql: SELECT m.rev_id FROM bench_mirror_flat FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP ? AS m WHERE m.article_id = ?

results.label: Bitemporal: application-time predicate on article_history FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF <checkpoint #1>
results.sql: SELECT h.rev_id FROM article_history FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP ? AS h WHERE h.article_id = ? AND h.valid_from <= ? AND h.valid_to > ? ORDER BY h.valid_from DESC LIMIT 1

tables.label: PARTITION BY SYSTEM_TIME INTERVAL 1 YEAR (8 partitions)
tables.ddl: PARTITION BY SYSTEM_TIME INTERVAL 1 YEAR STARTS TIMESTAMP '2021-01-01 00:00:00' PARTITIONS 8

tables.label: PARTITION BY SYSTEM_TIME INTERVAL 1 MONTH (64 partitions)
tables.ddl: PARTITION BY SYSTEM_TIME INTERVAL 1 MONTH STARTS TIMESTAMP '2021-09-01 00:00:00' PARTITIONS 64

results.label: AS OF random T, one article
results.sqlTemplate: SELECT rev_id FROM <table> FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP ? WHERE article_id = ?

results.label: AS OF T in 2021-22, all articles
results.sqlTemplate: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(size_bytes) FROM <table> FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP ?

results.label: AS OF T in 2025-26, all articles
results.sqlTemplate: SELECT COUNT(*), SUM(size_bytes) FROM <table> FOR SYSTEM_TIME AS OF TIMESTAMP ?

results.label: BETWEEN a 1-month span, all versions
results.sqlTemplate: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <table> FOR SYSTEM_TIME BETWEEN TIMESTAMP ? AND TIMESTAMP ?

results.label: ALL row versions (full history)
results.sqlTemplate: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM <table> FOR SYSTEM_TIME ALL

maintenance.label: row-by-row purge
maintenance.sql: DELETE HISTORY FROM bench_stress_none BEFORE SYSTEM_TIME TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00'

maintenance.label: drop whole history partitions
maintenance.sql: ALTER TABLE bench_stress_year DROP PARTITION p0, p1

maintenance.label: DELETE HISTORY on a partitioned table
maintenance.sql: DELETE HISTORY FROM bench_stress_month BEFORE SYSTEM_TIME TIMESTAMP '2023-01-01 00:00:00'
